IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_CopperM: The copper holds %1: fluids don't mix. Empty it first.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_NotOneF: A mix of fluids: only one plain fluid goes into the copper.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_NoFluid: You have nothing with a fluid in it.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_NoRoomI: You have no empty container, nor one holding the same fluid with room.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_EmptyCo: Pours away all %1 L of %2. There's no getting it back.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_HearthH: Pour a fluid into the copper and light the fire: it heats towards 95 C and steams at 85 C. Fill your own containers from it.
The fire is out: the copper cools. Add fuel and light it.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_BankHel: Rake the fire down under its ash: it burns a third of the wood, keeps the copper about 50 C, warms only the two tiles round it and cooks a third as fast.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_StokeHe: Rake the embers up into a full fire: the copper heats towards 95 C and the firebox cooks at full speed.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_HearthH: Banked: the embers burn a third of the wood, keep the copper about 50 C, warm only the two tiles round them and cook a third as fast. Stoke the fire to bring the copper to the steam.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_Firebox: The fire is out. Add fuel and light it: the firebox cooks like an oven and warms what stands near it.
A full fire: the firebox cooks like an oven, and its warmth reaches stations within 2 tiles. Bank it to make the wood last.
Banked: the embers burn a third of the wood, warm only the two tiles round them and cook a third as fast. Stoke it for a full fire.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_PlaceHe: By a fire, under a roof
By a fire, in the open
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_PlaceEm: By banked embers, under a roof
By banked embers, in the open
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_InfoFin: Finished and waiting to be taken: %1
